high_level_description: The image is a news article snippet from Hindustan Times, dated 13 hours ago. The headline reads: "Earthquake of magnitude 7.5 hits Drake Passage, tsunami alert issued briefly | World News - Hindustan Times." The accompanying image is a map showing the location of the earthquake. The map is a simple grid with latitude and longitude lines, indicating the geographical coordinates of the event. A red dot marks the epicenter of the earthquake, which is located in the Drake Passage, a body of water between South America and Antarctica.
